title: Critical Connections in a Network
description: There are `n` servers numbered 0 to `n - 1` and connections forming an undirected network. Return all critical connections (bridges) whose removal disconnects servers. Output the count of critical connections.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `m`. Following `m` lines contain `u` and `v`.

sample_tests.explanation: Edge [1, 3] is the only critical connection (bridge).

hints: Use Tarjan's bridge-finding algorithm using DFS.
Track discovery time `disc[u]` and lowest reachable discovery time `low[u]`.
An edge (u, v) is a bridge if `low[v] > disc[u]`.
